Flexible cancellation, no drama

Cancel online in under a minute. Your refund depends on how early you cancel before pick-up time.

48+ hours before100%

Full refund of rental, add-ons and delivery. Zero cancellation fee.

24 – 48 hours before75%

Refund of rental and add-ons. Delivery fee is non-refundable.

6 – 24 hours before50%

Half of the rental amount is refunded.

Under 6 hrs / no-show0%

No refund, but your security deposit is never charged.

Refunds go to your original payment method in 3–5 working days. Free one-time reschedule up to 12 hours before pick-up. Cancellations due to our vehicle unavailability are always 100% refunded.

Good to know

Frequently asked questions

How do I cancel a booking?

Enter your booking ID and mobile number under “Manage or cancel a booking”, or call our helpline. You get a confirmation instantly.

How long do refunds take?

Refunds reach your original payment method within 3–5 working days of cancellation.

What documents do I need?

A valid driving licence for the vehicle type (two-wheeler or car) and a government photo ID. Foreign riders need an International Driving Permit.

Is there a security deposit?

Yes, a refundable deposit based on the vehicle class, returned after inspection on drop-off.

What if the bike breaks down?

Call our 24×7 helpline. We repair on site or swap the bike at no extra cost.

Can I return it in another city?

One-way rentals are available between selected hubs for a small fee.

Your next road is one tap away
